The four decision files named by the stage contract were absent from this disposable copy, so the project design, supplied inline controller material, source, tests, and upstream reports were used as architectural evidence.
The owner-deferred camera occlusion during some drops and below-ground position at minimum pitch are accepted limitations and are not findings.
decisionsProposed: Define obstruction behavior when the first camera hit is closer than CAMERA.minDistance, enforce the chosen invariant in followCamera.ts, and add a fake-query regression case below 0.8 m.
lessonsProposed: Camera collision tests need a near-obstacle boundary case; testing only 1 m and 2 m hits left the configured 0.8 m minimum entirely unexercised.

findings.trigger: Stand flush with a camera-blocking wall and orbit so the desired camera path crosses it, producing a sphere-cast hit closer than the configured 0.8 m minimum distance.
findings.consequence: The camera is placed at the raw near hit distance, which can collapse it to roughly 0.1 m from the upper-body pivot and put the view inside the avatar or against the near plane instead of preserving a usable minimum view distance.
findings.evidence: Line 88 computes allowed as hit divided by the full segment length and lines 90-92 apply that fraction without consulting cfg.minDistance. A repository search finds minDistance only at components/game/config.ts:57, where it is set to 0.8; the fake-query tests exercise hits of 2 m and 1 m only. With the 0.30 m capsule radius, 0.01 m skin, and 0.20 m camera probe, a wall adjacent to the player can yield a center travel near 0.11 m.
findings.rule: Design section 2.7 requires pull-in to preserve CAMERA.minDistance, and robustness requires configured safety bounds to be enforced and covered at their boundary.
